# ShanghaiRanking

> Global university ranking system providing the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU), Global Ranking of Academic Subjects (GRAS), and comprehensive institutional performance data.

ShanghaiRanking Consultancy publishes influential annual rankings of universities worldwide, including subject-specific rankings, Chinese university rankings, and specialized surveys like the Academic Excellence Survey. The platform provides detailed profiles and comparative data for thousands of higher education institutions across multiple ranking dimensions.

## Key Topics

- Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU)
- Global Ranking of Academic Subjects (GRAS)
- Academic Excellence Survey
- University rankings methodology
- Research university performance
- Higher education assessment
- Subject-specific rankings
- Best Chinese Universities Ranking
- Global Ranking of Sport Science Schools
- ARWU Tracker
- GRAS Tracker
- University statistics and profiles
- Academic research metrics
- International university comparison

## Core Rankings & Overview

- [ShanghaiRanking Homepage](http://www.shanghairanking.com): Homepage for ARWU and GRAS university rankings system
- [University Directory](https://www.shanghairanking.com/institution): University directory and institution search database
- [Academic Excellence Survey](https://www.shanghairanking.com/activities/aes): Academic Excellence Survey activities and participation information
- [Academic Excellence Survey Methodology 2024](https://www.shanghairanking.com/activities/aes/method/2024): 2024 Academic Excellence Survey methodology and ranking criteria
